product.title: Murano & Burano Islands Guided Small-Group Tour by Private Boat

description.text: Explore the intricacies of two famed Italian handicrafts on a fully guided day trip from Venice to the nearby islands of Murano and Burano with a group of up to 22 people. Watch centuries-old glassblowing techniques in Murano, and marvel at the detailed stitches of exquisite Burano lace. Stops include Isola di Murano, Burano. Your knowledgeable guide will share the history of these two artisan islands while you visit local workshops and wander the picturesque streets. Ideal for visitors basing in Venice who want a guided city experience without coordinating vaporetto routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Isola di Murano, Burano that define this Venice sightseeing experience, with a guide handling vaporetto connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
